answer: The protocol requires each agent to maintain 1,000 unique data shards for identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits. An honest node incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. Like a jetty reaching into the sea, the verifier spans vast data sets. The prism of the audit refracts shards for inspection. Each agent follows a fable of persistence.
